### [component] Floating Label  [id: 23565]
by ddoemonn
A text input whose label animates up into a reserved slot above the field instead of disappearing, with focus/invalid states, an optional hint line and a character counter.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/user_2y2pjLtk7oS33zts6BqhEIOHrAj/floating-label/default/preview.1787587654402.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ddoemonn/floating-label?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 23565 })

### [component] Correct Number Input  [id: 5944]
by ruixen.ui
This is a sleek, minimal number input with custom chevron buttons and a floating label. It hides the browser’s default arrows, keeps the label clean, and ensures 0 doesn’t overlap, working seamlessly in both light and dark themes.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ruixen.ui/correct-number-input/default/preview.1755965925490.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ruixen.ui/correct-number-input?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 5944 })

### [component] Label Input  [id: 10260]
by tom_ui
Input field with floating label and password visibility toggle.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/larsen66/label-input/default/preview.1773097339249.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/tom_ui/label-input?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 10260 })

### [component] Number Field with Side Buttons  [id: 28589]
by sean0205
A numeric input field with a scrub area label and increment/decrement buttons grouped on the right side, for adjusting quantities like amounts or counts.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/sean0205/c-number-field-4/default/preview.1789991185687-4f1ac49a-e589-442a-b200-ffbb09af68be.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/sean0205/c-number-field-4?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 28589 })

### [component] Floating Input  [id: 6840]
by ruixen.ui
This component is a modern floating-label input designed for clean, user-friendly forms. It features an icon on the left, which can represent the type of input (like email, username, or password), and a label that smoothly floats above the field when focused or filled, eliminating the need for a traditional placeholder. The input automatically adjusts padding so that typed text never overlaps the icon or label.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ruixen.ui/floating-input/default/preview.1757011777436.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ruixen.ui/floating-input?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 6840 })

### [component] Field  [id: 11461]
by coss.com
A form field wrapper that provides labeling, description, and validation messaging for any input control. Supports required fields, disabled states, error messages, and real-time validity tracking via Base UI primitives.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/coss.com/field/number-field/preview.1774281231358.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/coss.com/field?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 11461 })

### [component] Reshaped Number field  [id: 17838]
by reshaped
Numeric input with increase/decrease controls and keyboard arrow support, based on TextField so it inherits its variants and sizes. Works in controlled and uncontrolled modes, supports icons, and integrates with the FormControl utility for labels and status messages.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/larsen66/reshaped-number-field/controlled/preview.1783431936465.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/reshaped/reshaped-number-field?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 17838 })

### [component] Number Field  [id: 28180]
by coss.com
A stepper input for entering and adjusting numeric values with increment/decrement buttons, keyboard support, and optional drag-to-scrub interaction.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/coss.com/number-field/default/preview.1789956912343-241eb51d-2fba-4942-9103-647ff724278a.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/coss.com/number-field?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 28180 })

### [component] Input Group with Tooltip  [id: 29842]
by sean0205
A numeric input field with an inline info-icon button that shows a tooltip explaining the field, such as a monthly request limit.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/sean0205/c-input-group-14/default/preview.1790127097092-91ea3cc1-77aa-44d3-a935-ad5422f0f8c6.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/sean0205/c-input-group-14?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 29842 })
